rubric: REVISION-FINAL §2: significado, cifras/negaciones y naturalidad, 0–3; RUNBOOK §8: cero errores botones/cifras/negaciones, ≤1 leve/20 y contratos de datos válidos.
scope: Direct current source/forward/back reading of 40 Korean model references; separate27 legacy in review-context-v16-legacy.json. No native review, inherited grades or backtranslation-only approval.
notes: A correct back can hide a bad forward: legacy 이력서→Resume and model 녹화→recording. Forward judged directly.
Canonical numeric multiplicity is deliberately conservative: six→6 changes token count while preserving value. Record as unsupported contract/notation, not a fabricated value error.
Models/INT8 unchanged vs v15. No language approval, engine freeze, tool activation or publication.

evidence_sources.use: Official dictionary: 녹화 denotes video recording, distinguish from audio 녹음.
Official 이하 includes equality at the threshold. Agent direct Korean reading identifies 미만 as strict less-than.
Official CAD term 도면 단위 for drawing units.
Primary Korean research institute uses 이력서 as résumé; agent direct reading distinguishes continuing a saved game.
